reason: My architect already does 3D for us, and my buyers have never once asked to see a home before it's built. We sell off photos of finished homes, so I can't see where $1,500 a plan fits when I have 20-plus plans.
objection: I don't have a problem this solves. Nobody has asked for it, my architect already covers 3D, and paying per home across a big plan library adds up fast for something buyers don't request.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that buyers sign faster or pay more for upgrades when they walk the home first, ideally with a flat price for my whole plan library instead of per-home pricing.
